'''July 2001 Durham tournament (29 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Durham, NC on 29 July 2001. It is known from Edwin Harris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2733">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-durham-nc-7-29-01d2733/ durham-nc-7-29-01], DeckTech (Edwin "Edwin" Harris, 30 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-durham-nc-7-29-01d2733/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Durham, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
